title: Your day belongs to your patients.
lines: Your day belongs to your patients. Insurance admin shouldn't run the practice. Meet Denta Bill.

title: One place to start.
lines: Bring your open claims into one workspace.
Keep the original claim, procedure, service date, and source identity together. Your team starts with the facts in view, and a clear place to begin the follow-up.

title: Follow the conversation.
lines: Here's a simulated follow-up, using synthetic data.
Watch the claim move from an I V R menu to a representative conversation. Denta Bill supplies the subscriber and service date, then captures the response in one readable timeline.
This demonstration simulates both the call and its analysis. No payer is contacted.

title: A clearer next step.
lines: Instead of digging through notes, your team sees a reported status, representative, reference number, and suggested next step.
This claim is pending, and stays in manual review. The evidence is there when a person needs to make the decision.

title: Make the numbers explain themselves.
lines: Now review separate, imported financial evidence.
Two remittances total one hundred and eighty dollars. A thirty-dollar provider adjustment brings the batch to one hundred and fifty. Your team can inspect the source before accepting it.

title: Preview. Review. Match.
lines: Review a separate, one-hundred-and-fifty-dollar cash-source record. Bank verification remains unverified in this demo.
Match one hundred, then the remaining fifty. The preview shows what is reserved and what remains available before each decision.

title: Keep every connection clear.
lines: Keep receipt headers and line items visible, even when they differ. Here, the header is one hundred and fifty, while the entries total one hundred and eighty.
Link an entry to an exact claim and procedure, or keep the association at claim level.

title: A correction. Without losing the story.
lines: Then the source changes. The corrected batch is one hundred and forty.
Earlier reservations stay visible, and another match is blocked. Release them explicitly, review the new match, and see the remaining ten dollars in cash-source capacity.
The original records and released matches are still there. Your team can follow what changed.

title: A history you can follow.
lines: The audit trail keeps recorded actions and available actor details visible, alongside the earlier evidence and released relationships.
From the first follow-up to the next review, the work stays connected.

title: More focus for your practice.
lines: Less piecing together. A clearer next step for your practice. Denta Bill. Explore the workflow, and see how your team could work.
